checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed terminal step 7200. Main phase_closure_detail needs low-urban >=+8/160 against each historic benchmark with 95% paired lower bound >0 and Clean >= best old control. execution.gpu_policy: Physical {0,3,5,7}, >=12288 MiB free and <8 currently visible compute contexts, at most one new worker per card. Preserve all other owners.
execution.stop_rule: Stop own worker on invalid contract, nonfinite gradient or waveform, failed real source/frozen checkpoint smoke, or incomplete artifact. Independent CPU truth only after the two complete matrices freeze. No target.

notes: Same trained network, observation weights, retained-observation projection, Clean gate, augmentations, steps and optimizer across arms. Joint source alignment used in both. Two independently fit weights, identical initial model.

Within each 32-sample tile, lags 1,3,7 form x[n-d] x[n+d] conj(x[n])^2 using amplitude-normalized soft phasors. Affine phase cancels; damping makes near-zero magnitude samples contribute less. For each lag retain both the complex mean and its modulation by centered local amplitude. Complex feature error separately penalizes the tile average and deviations around the average, weight .4/.6.

The candidate changes .45 paired spectrum detail to .20 of that same detail plus .25 of the closure penalty. All other loss terms match. The closure descriptor is a source signal quantity, not a TX label or teacher.

Both arms share the same 512+512 disjoint legal U_s geometry, threshold and dispersion calibration per dataset. Fitting uses 24174 LoRa and 52604 WiSig physical U_s marks. Allowed source pairs have one waveform and two different independent simulations.
